verdict.rationale: Community users say WezTerm's configuration is written in Lua, which makes it real code that is easy to diff and apply (comm-2, comm-19). The config file auto-reloads, shell integration exposes user vars, and the CLI was hands-on verified as a scriptable control loop (spawn, send-text, get-text). However, no first-party evidence shows a plugin system or a Lua extension API that goes beyond setting options. missing for 10: first-party docs on Lua scripting or event hooks, a plugin mechanism, evidence of custom actions or extensions beyond configuration values.
